## Natural history notes

A medium-sized cockroach characterized by its glossy brown body, shield-like pronotum, long antennae, and flattened oval shape, with females commonly reproducing without males. In Florida, it is found in warm, humid habitats such as gardens, greenhouses, mulch, compost, leaf litter, potted plants, yards, and other moist disturbed areas. It feeds on decaying plant material and organic debris, helping break down litter, but it can become a nuisance in greenhouses, nurseries, and indoor plant containers when populations build up.
